title: sgl-sim: Scientific Mission Design & Wave Optics Simulator for Gravitational Lens Telescopes
description: An open-source scientific Python package adhering to Astropy and JOSS standards for mission design, relativistic ray-tracing, wave optics, J2 astroid caustics, and exoplanet deconvolution around Solar and Black Hole Gravitational Lenses.
